title: First-person tools: round 4 variations
desc: 39 new first-person takes from J's 844 ratings: 3 each for the no-note IMPROVEs (P1b, P1c, S2a, S2b, S2c, S3a, S3c, S4b, V1a, V1b), H1b heavy smash variations, H2a backhand reaching a mob beyond the crosshair, and C1d cross-cross-dash combos (0.7 s primed charge, ~12-block dash). Swords heavier and slower with a charge; mobs react on contact.
